headline: No date confirmed yet for the coming weekend
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page still carries the banner it posted for the August Bank Holiday weekend, "THE CAR BOOT IS OPEN THIS SUNDAY & MONDAY", which covered Sunday 30 and Monday 31 August. Those dates have now passed and the farm has not yet posted a notice for the coming Sunday, so we are not treating any specific date as confirmed. There is no postponement notice in place. The farm states its car boot sales run "every Sunday from early March, through to the Autumn" and on Bank Holiday Mondays, weather permitting, but it does not publish a fixed calendar. Check the banner on the official page or call 01932 244 822 for the recorded status before travelling.
